info.title: Lagrangian Testing Updates Stream
info.description: Binary WebSocket stream of testing/simulation updates. Each frame is a protobuf `lagrangian.testing.TestingStreamMessage` defined in testing_updates.proto. Control messages (e.g. stop) are out of band. OpenAPI cannot represent this binary WS stream, so it is documented here.

appServer.description: Lagrangian app server (use wss in production).

testingUpdates.title: Testing updates
testingUpdates.description: Per-test-run stream of simulation update frames.

testId.description: Test run UUID returned by POST /testing/start.

receiveTestingUpdates.summary: Receive testing update frames over the WebSocket.

TestingStreamMessage.name: TestingStreamMessage
TestingStreamMessage.title: Testing stream message
TestingStreamMessage.summary: One testing update: the [env][t] matrix of body-pose forwards plus optional camera frames.
